title: Culturally Grounded Personas in Large Language Models: Characterization and Alignment with Socio-Psychological Value Frameworks

bias_targets.methodology: Generating culturally-grounded personas based on World Values Survey (WVS) variables and analyzing their distribution and spatial patterns on the Inglehart-Welzel Cultural Map using frequent-pattern-mining.

Comparing the distributional alignment of LLM responses to the WorldValuesBench (WVB-Probe) survey against human reference distributions across different demographic groups (continent, residential area, and education level) using Earth Mover's distance (EMD).
Administering the Moral Foundations Questionnaire-2 (MFQ-2) to LLMs conditioned with culturally-grounded personas to analyze how moral judgments vary across different cultural configurations.
